title: SBSShot
body:
**SBSShot** is a Minecraft mod that allows you to capture **Side-by-Side (SBS) stereo 3D screenshots**, designed for VR headsets and 3D viewing environments.

## ✨ Features
- Capture stereoscopic 3D screenshots in SBS (Side-by-Side) format
- Simple one-key operation (default: "." key)
- Compatible with VR/HMD devices and cross-eye / parallel viewing methods
- Works in normal Minecraft gameplay without requiring a VR mod

## 🎮 What this mod changes
With SBSShot, your screenshots are no longer flat images — they become **immersive 3D scenes**.

- Landscapes gain depth, making mountains, caves, and structures feel more realistic
- Builds can be viewed with true spatial presence, enhancing showcase and sharing
- Action moments (combat, exploration) feel more dynamic when viewed in 3D

For example:
- A large castle build feels massive when viewed in stereo
- Deep caves look more intimidating with real depth perception
- Scenic views become more immersive, almost like standing inside the world

## 🕶 Viewing your screenshots
You can view SBS images using:
- VR headsets (HMD)
- 3D displays
- Cross-eye or parallel viewing techniques

Or try [SBS STEREO VIEWER](https://azo234.github.io/sbs-stereo-viewer) (the web viewer).

## ⌨ Controls
| Function | Key |
| -- | -- |
| Stereo screenshot | . (Period) |

---

Turn your Minecraft world into a **true 3D experience** — not just playing, but capturing depth itself.
